issues: P2 truncation persistence: SSECompletion only rejects finish_reason=="length"; other non-normal finish reasons (e.g. "content_filter") are accepted, and the reply is saved via addAssistant with status PASS. No test covers this. Allowlist "stop" (or no reason) instead of blocklisting "length".

P2 resident-only: LocalModelInventory.requireLoaded is a separate check before the chat POST. If Gemma is unloaded in between, the POST can trigger LM Studio's on-demand loading, which the code's own comment says must not happen. ttlMs=null lowers the risk but doesn't remove it. The startup script's docstring admits this race; the Swift code doesn't. Document it as advisory or check which model answered afterwards.

P2 truthful status in the window: NisiLocalTurn.run passes each piece of text to the window (onDelta) before requireComplete throws SSE_OUTPUT_LIMIT or SSE_INCOMPLETE, so the window may have shown a truncated reply that is then not saved. Window rollback isn't in the supplied source and GUI Send wasn't tested; not verified.

Limits (not defects): no reboot/login persistence test; no GUI Send test; the cause of the first-launch terminate is unknown, and appLaunch=request-accepted only means `open` returned exit 0, not that the app stayed running; the packet can't show whether `lms load -y` can evict other models under some LM Studio settings; the Swift network check (requireLoaded) has no unit test and relies on the single CLI observation.
